notes.title: Patch 1.5.7
notes.content:
We are taking your feedback seriously so we made sure to make both the DEMO and PROLOGUE of Primal Fray feel as good as possible. In this update we have some new features for you to check out. As well as squashing some annoying bugs!

Audio:
- Increased range of sound in settings (game can play louder now)
- Main Theme in menu now plays from the point it finished when coming back to menu
- Increased variety of tracks in Extraction Facility Biome

Bug fixes:
- Fixed a rare bug which made abilities trigger twice
- Fixed a bug which disabled the options button after losing a run in Prologue

In Summary:
The game softlock less and audio should be less annoying (especiialy when playing the tutorial biome).
Be sure to check it out and share your feedback with us on discord!

notes.title: 1.5.6 - Demo and Prologue Update
notes.content:
We are taking your feedback seriously so we made sure to make both the DEMO and PROLOGUE of Primal Fray feel as good as possible. In this update we have multiple new features for you to check out. As well as squashing some annoying bugs!

[h3]Game Feel:[/h3]
- Added camera movement highlighting key actions during combat (toggable)
- Added screenshake (toggable)
- Added stop frames and slow motion on unit deaths
- Added mana generation and spending visualisation (crystals flying to and from units)
- Earned currencies now drop into the vials
- Fight speed up now has values of (1x / 3x / 5x) instead of (1x / 1,5x / 2x)

[h3]Audio:[/h3]
- Better mastering of sound
- More high quality SFX for units
- More high quality SFX for effects and explosions
- New sound indicating enemy movement

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed softlock after enemy movement
- Fixed softlock after attacking an enemy
- Fixed continuity errors present on exiting fights in crucial moments
- Exiting the tutorial before reaching it's conclusion doesn't check it as done now
- Fixed white "on hit" material staying on the screen indefinitely
- Fixed Spreading Flames boon which shouldn't have influenced enemy units
- Earning more than 20 boons doesn't freeze the game now (wow we didn't think it was possible!) 
- Fixed walking sound which would play indefinitely after exiting to menu while a unit is walking
- Sometimes after destroying water abilities interacting with empty tiles wouldn't highlight them immediatly
- Sometimes movement distance wasn't shown properly
- Fixed the exploit which could softlock the tutorial by leaving and reentering combat on certain frames
- Fixed multiple text and visual errors

[h3]In Summary:[/h3]
The game shouldn't sfotlock you anymore and feel more responsive to play.
Be sure to check it out and share your feedback with us on discord!

notes.title: Primal Fray Devlog #04 – Overcharge Mode
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Sky Adventurers![/b]

In today's devlog, let's discuss Overcharge Mode – a challenging game mode that becomes available after you finish the Elemental run.

Sooner or later, you'll reach the end of the Elemental Run. But even then, the game won't be over! Completing the run unlocks Overcharge Mode, a special mode where you can adjust the difficulty settings of various aspects of the run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/28e2df129387821c2bad42870ea87ed0319a2e85.gif[/img]

You can adjust the following settings:
[list]
[*] Frenzied Enemies – enemies deal more damage
[*] Sturdy Enemies – enemies have more health
[*] Big and Healthy – bosses have more health
[*] General's Call – boss fights involve additional enemies
[*] Downgrade – some of your base upgrades are disabled
[*] ...and much more!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/44bf1b99ea735ecf9c1867c43b2b44692ade43e8.gif[/img]

Just to give you an example, I started a run with some of those settings: bosses with extra HP, enemies dealing more damage, and enemies spawning at a higher tier.

The start was manageable, though the enhanced enemies gave me some trouble. I managed to scrape my way to the boss, and even then, things didn't seem too bad...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/b52c3101bce96ab89c75ffa809ca73ba71cff2f8.gif[/img]

...Until Inferia wiped 3 Primals off the map in a single attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/c7ad43febc29f1a5acf2f8046b70f03cd1112553.gif[/img]

Overcharge Mode allows you to tinker with almost all aspects of gameplay, pushing your skills to the limit even more than the base run. Every single move counts, and mastering this mode is incredibly satisfying.

That's it for today's devlog! Let me know what you think below. Thank you for reading and see you in a couple of weeks!

[b]Cheers![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2357350/Primal_Fray/

notes.title: Primal Fray Devlog #03 – Dancing with the Bosses
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Sky Adventurers![/b]

In today's devlog, let's talk about the most powerful enemies you'll encounter in the Rift: the bosses!

At the end of every biome (i.e., 3 times in a run) you'll face a mighty boss that you'll need to defeat in order to progress.

The first one you'll face is the [b]Mechataur[/b], who awaits you at the end of the first run (Ironclad Training Facility). Although it's a 'tutorial' boss, don't underestimate its rocket attacks – they deal quite a bit of damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/48096d6380955e94e660edb5a2ab1399f07f0718.gif[/img]

Upon completing the Ironclad Training Facility, you'll gain access to the Elemental Run. This is where the fun (and true challenge) begins. There are five bosses ready to kick you right back where you came from.

[h1][b]Maestitia[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/f6af227982a0d4d334f310cf30168b7f95873656.gif[/img]

This fearsome ice dragon fires a laser beam that damages everything in its path. Plus, she can turn the ground into ice and use it to unleash heavy attacks. To defeat her, you'll need to keep moving and watch the ground below.

[h1][b]Hortensius[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/98c74e6aa9612403e50f068dc2c1ebaca764d97a.gif[/img]

The forest god can spawn bushes, which can later transform into Nature Spirits. The less bushes on the map, the better – while the Spirits deal only minor damage, they can still overwhelm you in great numbers.

[h1][b]Absun[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/145ec9d36e852bd00826682b32f5a63ca51b93f1.gif[/img]

This four-armed deity uses powerful AoE attacks and spawns enemies. The longer the fight goes on, the stronger those enemies become, so will you focus on the boss, or take care of the minions first?

[h1][b]Inferia[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/c83ec39ae43643251cb4fe0f591f66894712f506.gif[/img]

The lady of fire wields her clubs to rain flames on your Primals. To defeat her, is pay close attention to where the fireballs will land on the next turn.

[h1][b]Catus[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/ca5d98e9b8b53ba8faf94d1625026ad8cdc9e069.gif[/img]

This desert snake may not deal a lot of damage, but its wind blasts can blow your Primals off the map! Properly positioning your allies is key here.


As you play Primal Fray, you'll eventually encounter all of the bosses above. Good luck then (you're going to need it).


That's it for today's devlog. Let me know what you think below. Thank you for reading and see you in a couple of weeks!

[b]Cheers![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2357350/Primal_Fray/

notes.title: Primal Fray Devlog #01 – The Secrets of the Rift
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Sky Adventurers![/b]

First and foremost, [b]welcome to the first Primal Fray Steam Devlog![/b] Each devlog will cover various aspects of Primal Fray. Today's topic – the Rift!

[b]The Rift is the mysterious world of Primal Fray.[/b] Here, you will encounter enemies as well as earn gold (more on that later). Every run in Primal Fray is generated procedurally, so no two runs are the same. There are 8 island types in total, and you can choose their order before starting a run. Each island type contains different types of hostile Primals, allowing you to decide which type you’ll fight first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/98568f2651674e1afbc0fe7dae255356c909558c.gif[/img]

Not only that, but you can choose your next island to visit during runs. This way, you can plan your path ahead as you visit the islands on your faithful dragon named Carrot. Carrot will help you on your journey, although she won't take part in battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/ac694b65530481d267c20dccccc4980e630669a5.gif[/img]

[b]The islands of the Rift hold many surprises, but not all of them are hostile![/b] In fact, most islands will grant you benefits, such as:
[list]
[*] gold – you can spend it in a merchant's shop later; will you survive that long, though?
[*] gems – needed for upgrading your Primals and your base of operations;
[*] Primals – they will assist you in battles; choose carefully though, as certain Primals are especially useful in specific regions;
[*] boons – they grant extra buffs to your team; for example, enemies set on fire can spread it to others!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/3cd9066be78661f20d36e8266d25e033e738a3c7.gif[/img]

The islands themselves are also procedurally generated, so you can't just rely on a one-size-fits-all strategy. [b]Some enemies will fly, some will dig their way behind your Primals. Some islands will have water you can freeze, and some will have high ground where you can position airborne Primals. [/b]Study the abilities of both enemy and friendly Primals to win!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/a2aea811e039de499a44e7ead1e10db4d7351999.gif[/img]

At the end of each run, a boss awaits you, ready to put your tactical skills to the test.[b] The bosses use powerful AoE attacks, making it difficult to position your Primals and attack at the same time.[/b] Of course, there are solutions to that, like granting shields to your teammates – but it depends on which Primals you have on board. Will you defeat the boss and achieve victory or return home empty-handed?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831841/48096d6380955e94e660edb5a2ab1399f07f0718.gif[/img]

And once you show the boss who's... well... boss (sorry), you'll return to base, use your hard-earned gems to upgrade it, and prepare to enter the Rift once again. This time, maybe with a different start boon? Or a different zone order? Or an entirely different type of run? It's all up to you.

That's it for today's devlog. Let me know what you think below. Thank you for reading and see you in a couple of weeks!

[b]Cheers![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2357350/Primal_Fray/
